instructions: Log ONLY real workflow blockers observed during contractor usage. Severity: critical | high | medium | low. No hypothetical improvements.

severityDefinitions.critical: Workflow blocked — contractor cannot complete task
severityDefinitions.high: Significant slowdown — workaround exists but painful
severityDefinitions.medium: Noticeable friction — does not block daily work
severityDefinitions.low: Minor annoyance — backlog only after beta
